note: Single canonical mapping for the circular workforce. Codes normalize on the E<digit> prefix: Axiom writes E1-E4, Draymond business-pipeline writes E1-platform..E4-vertical; both map to the same engine.

lane.description: Axis A - audience lane (voice, tone, targeting). Personas in config/workforce/personas/.
lane.source: Axiom MissionState.lane (AXIOM_MISSION_LANE) once tagged; absent = unknown

engine.description: Axis B - revenue engine. Tracked by the Treasurer; settled money only.

canonical_values.E3-tooling: Business tooling / API (audits, SCA, agent building)
canonical_values.E4-vertical: Vertical products (music rights, sports intel, research, publishing)

engine.normalization: match /^E([1-4])/i against the trimmed value; result is E1..E4

correlation_fields.description: Optional additive fields. Absent means unknown; never inferred.

report.output_note: Reads .draymond but does not write there (brain-dir write boundary); override with DRAYMOND_CIRCLE_REPORT_DIR
report.invariant: settled = invoices.status 'paid' + treasury settled charges; pipeline is never revenue

known_gaps: Evidence-ledger records are not yet linked by refId to missions/opportunities; verified evidence is counted globally and flagged unlinked.
Missions from Axiom are stamped with engine only when a pillar is supplied (AXIOM_MISSION_PILLAR); otherwise engine is absent and surfaces as a broken link.
Lane tagging is new (2026-09-17); existing missions predate it and will report as missionsWithoutLane.
